segments.text: Think you know Vim? Or maybe you've always wanted to learn it, but the steep learning curve kept you away.
Introducing Vim Master, an in browser game that transforms learning VH into a fun interactive challenge. VH Master
doesn't just teach you keystrokes. It validates the outcomes of your actions, ensuring you truly understand how Vimh
works. With a progression of 16 carefully designed levels, you'll gradually master the fundamentals.
Navigate with H, J, K, L. Jump with words, lines, and patterns. Edit with
DD, DW, CW, Y, Y, P, X. Explore insert modes and X commands like Q and WQ. But
that's just the start. Vim Master supports numeric motions, undo, redo, full text searching, and more, just like
the real editor. Once you've built the basics, challenge mode pushes your skills under time pressure, while cheat
mode offers an interactive, always available reference to practice instantly. And to keep the motivation high, you'll unlock badges, track
progress, and even share beautiful canvas-based achievement cards with friends. Whether you're a complete beginner or sharpening your editing
edge, Vim Master makes learning Vim simple, visual, and
